title: Optimal any-angle path planning in static and dynamic environments
abstract: arXiv:2607.00065v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Any-angle path planning extends traditional graph-based path planning by allowing movement between any pair of vertices, rather than being restricted by predefined edges. It can find straighter and shorter paths in continuous space with graphs, making it particularly suitable for navigation in open areas. Many any-angle path-planning algorithms have been proposed, but only a few can guarantee optimal solutions. To address this challenge, this article focuses on optimal any-angle path planning on grids and introduces two general techniques that accelerate computation while preserving optimality in both static and dynamic environments: 1) elliptical forward expansion, which leverages ellipse-based neighborhoods to restrict the search space, and 2) field of view, which replaces traditional line-of-sight methods to speed up visibility checks. To integrate these two techniques, inverted and forward scanning are introduced. Inverted

translated_title: 静态与动态环境中的最优任意角路径规划
translated_abstract: 任意角路径规划扩展了传统的基于图的路径规划方法，它允许在任意两个顶点之间移动，而不受预定义边的限制。该方法可以在连续空间中利用图找到更直、更短的路径，因此特别适用于开阔区域的导航。目前已有许多任意角路径规划算法被提出，但只有少数能够保证解的最优性。为了应对这一挑战，本文聚焦于网格上的最优任意角路径规划，并提出了两种通用技术，在静态和动态环境中都能在保持最优性的同时加速计算：1）椭圆前向扩展，利用基于椭圆的邻域来限制搜索空间；2）视野法，用以替代传统的视线检测方法，从而加速可见性检查。为了整合这两种技术，本文还引入了反向扫描和前向扫描方法。
tldr: 本文针对网格上的最优任意角路径规划问题，提出椭圆前向扩展和视野法两种通用技术，并辅以反向和前向扫描加以整合，在静态与动态环境中均能在保证最优性的前提下显著加速计算。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two general techniques, elliptical forward expansion and field of view, integrated via inverted and forward scanning, that accelerate optimal any-angle path planning on grids while preserving optimality in both static and dynamic environments.
